newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Seven stocks fell, three rose and five were flat in 5.3-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index up 0.1 percent to 1,483.1 points.
The remaining eight stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent to 138 zlotys in a 5.5-million-zloty turnover.
Four National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell, one rose, seven were flat and the rest did not trade.
